findings.title: Sampled pages have no inbound link from any other sampled page
findings.evidence: 1 sampled pages are not linked to by any other page in this sample -- orphan-like within the sampled graph. This does not establish that the page is globally unreachable, only that no other page this audit observed points to it. Examples: https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/1000-places-to-see-before-you-die_1/index.html.

evidence_detail.method: every internal link URL across every sampled page, normalised and compared against each sampled page's own URL
evidence_detail.expected: at least one other sampled page links to this page
evidence_detail.note: scoped explicitly to the sampled graph; a page reached only through pages outside the sample, or through a sitemap alone, would appear orphan-like here without genuinely being orphaned

suggested_action.summary: Link to these pages from at least one other relevant page in the site's own content or navigation.
how: Identify a relevant category, hub or related-content page for each listed URL.
Add a direct link to it from there.
suggested_action.mechanism: A page with no inbound link from anything else this audit sampled is reachable only through a sitemap or direct URL knowledge, which is a weaker discovery and continuation path than an in-content link from a related page.
suggested_action.verification: Re-check the site's sampled link graph and confirm at least one other page now links to this URL.
